description: Ahrefs is an SEO and digital marketing platform that provides backlink, keyword, SERP, site audit, rank tracking, brand visibility, and related analytics data. It also offers integrations so third-party apps and AI tools can access Ahrefs workspace data on behalf of users.
summary: Ahrefs exposes a REST API at `api.ahrefs.com/v3` authenticated with bearer API keys, a documented public-endpoints subset at `api.ahrefs.com/v3/public` with unclear per-endpoint auth requirements, and a hosted OAuth-capable MCP server at `api.ahrefs.com/mcp/mcp` that also supports manual bearer MCP keys.
